title: Lesson 17: The Longest Suspension Bridge in the World
audio: /audio/nce3/17－The Longest Suspension Bridge in the World.mp3

segments.text: The longest suspension bridge in the world
Verrazano, an Italian about whom little is known, sailed into New York Harbour in 1524 and named it Angouleme.
segments.translation: 维拉扎诺是一个几乎不为人知的意大利人，他于1524年驶入纽约港，并将其命名为昂古莱姆。

segments.text: He described it as 'a very agreeable situation located within two small hills in the midst of which flowed a great river.'
segments.translation: 他将其描述为“一个非常宜人的地方，位于两座小山丘之间，中间流淌着一条大河”。

segments.text: Though Verrazano is by no means considered to be a great explorer, his name will probably remain immortal, for on November 21st, 1964, the longest suspension bridge in the world was named after him.
segments.translation: 虽然维拉扎诺绝不被认为是一个伟大的探险家，但他的名字可能会名垂青史，因为在1964年11月21日，世界上最大的悬索桥以他的名字命名。

segments.text: The Verrazano Bridge, which was designed by Othmar Ammann, joins Brooklyn to Staten Island.
segments.translation: 维拉扎诺大桥由奥思马·阿曼设计，连接布鲁克林和斯塔滕岛。

segments.text: It has a span of 4, 260 feet.
The bridge is so long that the shape of the earth had to be taken into account by its designer.
segments.translation: 大桥如此之长，设计师不得不考虑到地球的形状。

segments.text: Two great towers support four huge cables.
segments.translation: 两座巨大的塔楼支撑着四根巨大的缆索。

segments.text: The towers are built on immense underwater platforms made of steel and concrete.
segments.translation: 塔楼建在钢材和混凝土制成的巨大水下平台上。

segments.text: The platforms extend to a depth of over 100 feet under the sea.
segments.translation: 平台延伸到海底100多英尺深。

segments.text: These alone took sixteen months to build.
segments.translation: 仅这些平台就花了16个月才建成。

segments.text: Above the surface of the water, the towers rise to a height of nearly 700 feet.
segments.translation: 在水面上，塔楼升至将近700英尺的高度。

segments.text: They support the cables from which the bridge has been suspended.
segments.translation: 它们支撑着悬挂大桥的缆索。

segments.text: Each of the four cables contains 26, 108 lengths of wire.
segments.translation: 四根缆索中的每一根都包含26,108段钢丝。

segments.text: It has been estimated that if the bridge were packed with cars, it would still only be carrying a third of its total capacity.
segments.translation: 据估计，如果大桥上挤满了客车，它仍然只承载其总能力的1/3。

segments.text: However, size and strength are not the only important things about this bridge.
segments.translation: 然而，规模和强度并不是这座大桥唯一的重点。

segments.text: Despite its immensity, it is both simple and elegant, fulfilling its designer's dream to creat 'an enormous object drawn as faintly as possible'.
segments.translation: 尽管其庞大，但它既简洁又优美，实现了设计师的梦想：创造“一个画得尽可能淡的巨大物体”。
